name: Crosswind: Airport Tycoon
subtitle: Build Your Airport Empire
promotionalText: Turn a grass airstrip into an international hub. Sign airlines, turn every flight round on time, and trade up to bigger, tougher airports.
description: A grass strip, one small stand and a windsock. Crosswind hands you the keys and asks one thing: build the airport everyone wants to fly to.
RUN THE AIRFIELD
- Sign routes with airlines, from little turboprops to wide-body jets that need their own stands.
- Turn every flight round on time: fuel, baggage, catering, cleaning, de-icing and pushback, with your crews and vehicles working each aircraft.
- Build and upgrade the runway, taxiways, stands with boarding bridges, the tower, hangar and cargo shed.
- Hire managers so departments run themselves while you plan the next move.
DESIGN THE TERMINAL
- Step inside and furnish the concourse yourself: coffee bars, shops, seating, lounges, an arcade and more.
- Watch passengers queue, shop and board. Meet their needs and your rating climbs.
THINK LIKE AN OPERATOR
- Fuel prices move every day: fill the tank farm when it's cheap, or pay for it when the tanks run dry.
- Landings wear the runway. Pick a quiet hour to resurface before it slows you down.
- Plan the day's schedule, keep airlines happy and choose the terms of each contract.
- Buy aircraft for your own airline and keep them maintained.
- Every airport day is graded A to E. Good days pay a bonus, and streaks pay more.
GROW AN EMPIRE
- Research new technology, train your managers and collect a team of specialists.
- Rain, fog and snow change the day. Take passing opportunities when they come up.
- Sell your airport for Wings that raise all income for good, then start again somewhere harder and richer: six airports to master.
- Your airport keeps earning while you're away.
PLAY TOGETHER
- Add friends by code, compare airports and swap a gift every day.
- Game Center leaderboards and achievements.
- Your save follows you between iPhone and iPad through iCloud.

Crosswind is free to play, with no ads. Optional in-app purchases include gems, the Founder's Pack and Golden Runway. Team crates are opened with gems and show their odds before you open one. Nothing in the game needs a purchase.
Made by Rushing Technologies.
